exposure: early termination (≤56 days) of the first cesarean scar pregnancy
Timing of termination of the first cesarean scar pregnancy
Thickness of the lower uterine segment
cesarean delivery history in rural community hospitals
History of irregular vaginal bleeding or lower abdominal pain in a previous cesarean scar pregnancy
lower abdominal pain in an earlier cesarean scar pregnancy
gestational sac bulging into the uterovesical fold
cohort: 21 women with recurrent cesarean scar pregnancies and 42 women with single cesarean scar pregnancies
finding: Risk factors for recurrent cesarean scar pregnancy included cesarean delivery history in rural community hospitals, thinner lower uterine segment, gestational sac bulging into the uterovesical fold, history of irregular vaginal bleeding or lower abdominal pain in a previous cesarean scar pregnancy, and early termination of the first cesarean scar pregnancy.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean delivery, particularly in a rural community hospital, was identified as a risk factor for recurrent cesarean scar pregnancies.
